prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
(empty)

New part:
S001: The warehouse operating boundary begins at the designated receiving interface and ends when a completed outbound load is released from the shipping interface.
S002: Pallets remain within this boundary while they are inspected, identified, buffered, stored, retrieved, and prepared for dispatch.
S003: Inbound acceptance is conditional on a valid receipt instruction and a pallet that can be safely handled within the facility.
S004: Inbound Inspection Desk records inspection outcomes before accepted pallets enter storage operations.
S005: Pallet Dimension Scanner captures dimensions used to determine handling and storage eligibility.
S006: Inbound Pallet Buffer holds accepted pallets temporarily when storage work cannot proceed immediately.
S007: Storage locations are assigned to support safe handling, efficient retrieval, and the required inventory controls.
S008: North Aisle Stacker Crane performs assigned storage and retrieval work in its designated aisle.
S009: South Aisle Stacker Crane performs assigned storage and retrieval work in its designated aisle.
S010: East Transfer Conveyor carries pallets along its designated transfer route.
S011: West Transfer Conveyor carries pallets along its designated transfer route.
S012: Conveyor Line Controller coordinates conveyor movement within its assigned operating scope.
S013: Autonomous Forklift Fleet moves pallets only within approved travel areas and under authorized tasking.
S014: Yard Gate Controller controls vehicle access at the facility perimeter.
S015: Outbound Dispatch Sorter organizes eligible pallets for their assigned dispatch sequence.
S016: Outbound Checkweigh Scale verifies pallet weight before shipment completion.
S017: Shipping Documentation Desk prepares the records required for outbound loads.
S018: Warehouse Operations Supervisor oversees exceptions, operational priorities, and recovery decisions.
S019: The Warehouse Management System, known as Morrowglass, is the authority for inventory records and the release of warehouse work.
S020: The Warehouse Management System maintains the authoritative status, location, and handling eligibility of each controlled pallet.
S021: No equipment may begin inventory-moving work without an authorized release from the Warehouse Management System.
S022: Physical movement and system inventory status are reconciled so that recorded locations remain dependable throughout operations.
S023: The service objective is to process accepted pallets accurately and meet committed dispatch times without bypassing safety or inventory controls.
S024: Safety Zone Controller enforces movement restrictions in designated protected areas.
S025: Fire Alarm Panel provides facility alarm status for operational response.
S026: Maintenance Release Terminal records equipment availability for operational planning.
S027: Inbound arrivals are checked against the scheduled delivery window before a door assignment is made.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
response:
{"summary":"Warehouse operating boundary: designated receiving interface through release of a completed outbound load from the shipping interface. Pallets remain inside during inspection, identification, buffering, storage, retrieval, and dispatch preparation.
Inbound acceptance requires a valid receipt instruction and a safely handleable pallet. Inbound arrivals must be checked against the scheduled delivery window before door assignment. Inbound Inspection Desk records inspection outcomes before accepted pallets enter storage operations. Pallet Dimension Scanner captures dimensions determining handling/storage eligibility. Inbound Pallet Buffer temporarily holds accepted pallets when storage cannot proceed. Storage locations must support safe handling, efficient retrieval, and required inventory controls.
North Aisle Stacker Crane and South Aisle Stacker Crane perform assigned storage/retrieval in their respective designated aisles. East Transfer Conveyor and West Transfer Conveyor carry pallets along their respective designated transfer routes. Conveyor Line Controller coordinates conveyor movement within its assigned scope. Autonomous Forklift Fleet moves pallets only in approved travel areas under authorized tasking. Yard Gate Controller controls perimeter vehicle access.
Outbound Dispatch Sorter organizes eligible pallets into assigned dispatch sequence. Outbound Checkweigh Scale verifies pallet weight before shipment completion. Shipping Documentation Desk prepares required outbound-load records. Warehouse Operations Supervisor oversees exceptions, operational priorities, and recovery decisions.
Warehouse Management System (alias: Morrowglass) is authoritative for inventory records and warehouse-work release; it maintains each controlled pallet’s authoritative status, location, and handling eligibility. No equipment may begin inventory-moving work without its authorized release. Physical movement and inventory status must be reconciled to keep recorded locations dependable.
Safety Zone Controller enforces movement restrictions in designated protected areas. Fire Alarm Panel provides facility alarm status for operational response. Maintenance Release Terminal records equipment availability for operational planning.
Service objective: accurately process accepted pallets and meet committed dispatch times without bypassing safety or inventory controls. No explicit operating modes specified."}
